mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, persistent inflation triggers aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in HOUST and RSAFS indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering earnings revisions that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising PAYEMS signals expanding labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth acceleration (GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% q/q, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average by >1.5%, manufacturing contraction reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below threshold, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous FEDFUNDS increase and CPIAUCSL decline signals disinflationary policy that reduces recession risk, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing market regimes (HOUST > 1200), rising RSAFS indicates strong consumer spending that supports revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.
